Menu_WatchClipboard: Watch clipboard (pin images copied to it)
Menu_ShowOnCapture: Briefly show the line after a capture
Msg_UpdateReady: Mandal {0} is ready. Install now? The app will restart.
Card_ClearLineTip: Takes unpinned cards off the line. Their files stay in the folder; nothing is deleted. Cards with a shortcut stay. To undo: tray menu → Put back last removed.
Card_ClearClipboardTip: Empties the Windows clipboard. Cards on the line and their files are not touched.
Note_SelectHint: Select text and release: it is copied
Settings_ConfirmDelete: Ask before removing a card from the line
Settings_KeepForever: Keep cards on the line (nothing is taken off automatically; files are never deleted)
Settings_AutoDelete: Otherwise, take cards off the line after {0} days (files stay in the folder; pinned cards and cards with a shortcut stay)
Msg_DeleteConfirm: Remove this card from the line? Its file stays in the folder.
Msg_LineCleared: {0} cards taken off the line. The files are still in the folder; to put them back: tray menu → Put back last removed.
Line_EmptyCard:
The line is empty.
Press {0} to capture a region, or copy an image to the clipboard.
Item_DeleteTip: Remove from the line (the file stays in the folder)
Item_Hint: Click: copy · Drag: move · Double-click: preview
Settings_PreviewTopmost: Keep the preview window above other apps
Item_PinTip: Pin: the card stays at the start of the line; drag to reorder
Item_PinnedHint: Pinned · drag sideways: reorder · pull down: drag into another app
Region_Hint: Select a region to capture   ·   Esc: cancel
Settings_HotkeyHint: Click a box and press the key combination. Backspace clears it. A single key works too: F1–F24, PrintScreen, numpad +.
Settings_HotkeyDuplicate: The same shortcut is used twice.
Settings_FolderInvalid: The folder could not be created.
Settings_HideOnLeave: Put the line away when the mouse leaves it
Settings_SelectOnCard: Select text directly on a note card (release to copy the selection; drag the clothespin to move the card)
Settings_Corner: Corner for the clothespin and hot corner
Settings_HotCorner: Open the line when the mouse touches that corner
Settings_CornerTab: Show a small clothespin in that corner (click to open)
Hotkey_Help: Press a key combination. Pressing it later copies this item to the clipboard, even after a restart.
Hotkey_Conflict: This shortcut is already in use.
Msg_Error: Something went wrong; details were written to the log.
Msg_HotkeysFailed: Some shortcuts could not be registered
Msg_HotkeyInUse: {0} is already used by another program
Msg_FolderFallback: The capture folder could not be used; the default folder is being used instead.
Msg_OcrNoEngine: Text recognition isn't available: no OCR language pack is installed in Windows.
Msg_OcrNoText: No text was found in the image.
Corner_Hide: Hide this clothespin (turn it back on from the tray menu)
